answer: A human witness must vouch for every name: that is what Nominated mushroom cultivation supervisor warrant with mushroom growers endorsement demands, since a warrant growers confirm after shed audits. A witness costs a fresh per check charge of £23, repeated on every one of 300 names per appearance, and the glacier is that the witness has to turn up for each clone separately. One honest agent books one witness; a farm books a hundred, and the timber is a calendar full of appointments while the vault stays the same flat reward.
